import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
sys.path.insert(0,"/work/scripts")
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
from irc_baseline_support import checked_packet
from run_irc_fit_probe import load_examples
from materialize_outcome_score_data import file_sha256,payload_sha256
from projection_transport_steering.reft_training import epoch_batches
root=Path("/work")
c=json.loads((root/"research/irc-baseline-config-v2-draft.json").read_text())
assert all(file_sha256(root/n)==h for n,h in c["source_sha256"].items())
fit=checked_packet(root,c,"fit"); selection=checked_packet(root,c["selection"],"selection")
assert len(fit)==1500 and len(selection)==256
tokenizer=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("/model/snapshots/b968826d9c46dd6066d109eabc6255188de91218",local_files_only=True,padding_side="right")
examples=load_examples({**c,"groups":{"fit":[r["cluster_id"] for r in fit]}},root,tokenizer)["fit"]
hist=Counter(); orders=[]; total=0; active=0
for epoch in range(12):
    groups=epoch_batches(examples,20260907,epoch,32)
    assert len(groups)==47 and len(groups[-1])==28
    assert sorted(i for group in groups for i in group)==list(range(1500))
    orders.append(payload_sha256(groups))
    for group in groups:
        for start in range(0,len(group),2):
            pair=[examples[i] for i in group[start:start+2]]
            size=next(b for b in [384,896,2816] if b>=max(len(x["input_ids"]) for x in pair))
            assert len(pair)==2
            hist[size]+=1
            total+=sum(len(x["input_ids"]) for x in pair)
print(json.dumps({"status":"pass","source_count":len(c["source_sha256"]),"fit_questions":1500,"selection_questions":256,"target_examples_sha256":payload_sha256(examples),"total_tokens_per_epoch":sum(len(x["input_ids"]) for x in examples),"target_tokens_per_epoch":sum(sum(y!=-100 for y in x["labels"][1:]) for x in examples),"maximum_length":max(len(x["input_ids"]) for x in examples),"epoch_order_sha256":orders,"padding_histogram":dict(hist),"padded_token_instances":sum(2*n*b for b,n in hist.items()),"unrounded_tokens_all_epochs":total,"optimizer_updates":564,"pair_steps":sum(hist.values()),"fit_ids_sha256":payload_sha256([r["cluster_id"] for r in fit]),"selection_ids_sha256":payload_sha256([r["cluster_id"] for r in selection])},sort_keys=True))
